description:
Audit found ~30-35% of "coverage wave" tests inflate metrics without validating behavior.
16 `assert True` instances always pass. 315 `assert hasattr` checks verify attributes exist
but never call them. 81 trivial `.columns` assertions exercise code without checking output.
Import-only tests get coverage credit for importing modules. Mock dispatch tests verify
mocks were called, not that behavior is correct.

This must be fixed BEFORE adding new coverage - otherwise the 80% target is built on
a foundation of tests that protect nothing. Net statement gain is ~0, but test suite
integrity improves dramatically.

Current coverage: 66.4% (79,444 / 115,498 statements).

anti_patterns.dont: add `# pragma: no cover` to bypass coverage on code that should be tested
anti_patterns.why: this TODO is about fixing test quality, not hiding gaps

anti_patterns.instead: fix the assertion to test real behavior
anti_patterns.why: the goal is to make tests meaningful, not to remove them

anti_patterns.dont: replace `assert True` with `assert result is not None`
anti_patterns.instead: assert on specific values, types, or state

preserves.behavior: All existing test markers (fast, unit, etc.) must be preserved
Coverage percentage must not drop below 66.2% - baseline updated from 66.4% after bc77a1adf excluded low-ROI bulk DF query sets from scope
Total test count must not decrease (currently 14,215 collected) - upgrade tests, don't delete them
